source: Visible ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-18 after Initialize All
observations: Exact visible ClassPad fx-880BTG PLUS after Initialize All, English. All samples include actual key histories and status flags.

Ans truncates real fractional values toward zero. The signed range includes -2147483648; all four base presentations of the minimum and maximum were measured. Ans outside that signed range reports Math ERROR, and Back selects the Ans token.
Ans with a nonzero imaginary component reports Math ERROR rather than discarding its imaginary part.
Intermediate addition and multiplication overflow report Math ERROR even when a later operation would bring the final result back into range. Parenthesized 2147483647+(1-1) is valid.

Hex FFFFFFFF and 80000000 are signed 32-bit words; subtracting 1 from the latter reports Math ERROR. Direct Decimal unary-negative literal 2147483648 also reports Math ERROR; Ans at the signed minimum is a distinct valid input.
